title: Signal: Possible an encrypted PKCS#8 private key block in source
scope: Single-line shape match for an encrypted PKCS#8 private key block.
limitations: Shape-only: matches the documented prefix and length family, which cannot prove a live credential.

examples.line: # audit: key = "-----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----" present

fpNotes: Documentation and redacted examples using the same prefix are the common false positives.
